title: Air quality observations (canonical model 2.1.0)
description: Hourly (or other averaging-period) air quality measurements reported by monitoring stations, grouped by station and sampling point (one sampling point = one pollutant measured at a station). Generated from model/airquality.model.yaml by tools/generate.py - do not edit.

StationKind.title: StationKind
StationKind.description: Classification of the station by its dominant emission source (EEA station type).

x-enumDescriptions.traffic: Station located such that its pollution level is determined predominantly by emissions from nearby traffic.
x-enumDescriptions.industrial: Station located such that its pollution level is influenced predominantly by nearby industrial sources.
x-enumDescriptions.background: Station whose pollution level is not influenced predominantly by any single source or street.

ValidityFlag.title: ValidityFlag
ValidityFlag.description: Validity of the measured value. ASSUMED to follow the EEA e-Reporting (AQD) observation validity code list; the XSD does not say so. See issue Q6.

oneOf.description: Valid, but below detection limit (value is the detection limit or a substitute).
Valid, but below limit of quantification.
Not valid due to station maintenance or calibration in progress.

VerificationFlag.title: VerificationFlag
VerificationFlag.description: Verification status of the value. ASSUMED to follow the EEA e-Reporting (AQD) observation verification code list. See issue Q6.

ObservationCollection.title: ObservationCollection
ObservationCollection.description: Exchange document. Root of a partner delivery (XML) or of a bulk ingestion request (JSON). Not intended as a REST resource for reads, see design note D1 in xsd-review.md.

stations.description: Stations contained in this delivery (at least one).

Station.title: Station
Station.description: A fixed air quality monitoring station.

id.description: Document-local identifier (xs:ID). Whether it is stable across deliveries and how it relates to stationCode is unspecified (Q1).

stationCode.description: Station code, presumably the business identifier (e.g. EEA/EoI local station code such as "DEBE065"). Treated as the canonical natural key in the API.

operator.description: Organisation operating the station (free text in 2.1).

stationType.description: Station classification by dominant emission source.

samplingPoints.description: Sampling points at this station (at least one).

Position.title: Position
Position.description: Geographic position. CRS is not stated in 2.1; ASSUMED WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), decimal degrees, latitude/longitude order. Altitude ASSUMED metres above mean sea level.

altitude.description: Altitude, assumed metres above mean sea level. Absent and null both mean "unknown" (2.1 allows both, see Q4).

SamplingPoint.title: SamplingPoint
SamplingPoint.description: Measurement of one pollutant at a station, with its time series of observations.

id.description: Document-local identifier (xs:ID). Must not collide with any station id in the same document.

pollutant.description: Code from the EEA pollutant vocabulary, e.g. NO2, PM10, O3.

unit.description: Unit of measurement of all values of this sampling point. Free text in 2.1; expected values such as "ug.m-3" (EEA notation) or "mg.m-3".

observations.description: Observations for this sampling point, may be empty.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: One aggregated measurement over the interval [begin, end), typically one hour.

begin.description: Start of the averaging period (inclusive). The JSON API requires a UTC offset; 2.1 XML allows a missing one (Q3b).

end.description: End of the averaging period (assumed exclusive). Must be after begin (not checkable in either schema language without extensions).

value.description: Measured value in the sampling point's unit. null = no value (e.g. instrument failure); validity should then be negative (Q7). NaN/INF are not allowed in the canonical model (Q15).
